final_allocation.fixture_live_model: 12 authored development cases, up to two repetitions = 24 single-review calls
final_allocation.native: 3 questions cold, 3 warm, and two batches of 3 concurrent = 12 single-review calls

rules: Allocation is in actual calls, not questions; double-call paths consume two.
Baseline first pass Q1/Q2/SCOPE before deciding whether second baseline pass changes a decision.
Freeze candidate/configuration before final repetitions; do not tune against final-run outcomes and call them untouched validation.
New unknown stops admission and preserves all reservations; no automatic paid retries.
No new provider, egress, source writes, scopes, global installation, publish, push or merge.
If budget headroom cannot cover a conservative reservation, stop before dispatch rather than overshoot USD0.50.
Authored development cases are not blind holdout or native identity validation.
Full answer frontend render time is measured separately from server/CLI time; tool browser refusal is not bypassed.
